تستنبئين (form X)
# تَسْتَنْبِئِينَ (tastanbiʔīna) /tas.tan.bi.ʔiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
# تُسْتَنْبَئِينَ (tustanbaʔīna) /tus.tan.ba.ʔiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْبَأَ (istanbaʔa)
